results.name: Bundled plugin loads in installed Obsidian; full-pane example canvas
Create board command, task record, inspector edits, quick dates and checklist persist
Completed pointer drag is one undo step; resize and 10,000+ coordinates persist
Reopen restores same task IDs and coordinates from Markdown
Inline rename, arrow nudging and card colours edit the record in place
Double-click on empty canvas creates a task there; context menu completes it
List editing, unplaced tray, placement removal, duplicate/delete and undo
External JSON edit reloads valid data, preserves coordinates, keeps undo, and highlights the change
Invalid JSON retains last valid display, disables writes, never overwrites source
Two open board views share one model and source-editor suspension prevents writes
Local edits racing an external change to another record are merged, not conflicted
Same-field overlap keeps local work, is listed for review, and can take the other side
Uncombinable changes enter Conflict; recovery copy and preserve/reload work
Reading-view preview is resizable and read-only; it does not suspend board writes
Vault-note picker creates a reference; target rename follows; deletion is explicit
Sticky safe preview does not mount raw HTML or fetch remote images
Frames move their explicit members once and ungroup without deleting tasks
Labelled connectors and dependency connectors have distinct storage; cycles are rejected
Dragging a connection onto empty canvas creates a linked task
Blocked completion warns, can be cancelled or accepted, and remains undoable
Kanban drag changes status only and keeps canvas positions
Search, status/priority/tag/due/blocked filters and presets preserve positions
Multi-selection, keyboard duplicate/undo, and shortcuts do not hijack text inputs
Source-editor in-progress text is revalidated after closing; raw export command works
Wheel input: trackpad deltas pan, mouse-wheel deltas zoom, Shift+wheel pans sideways
Zoom, fit, minimap, snapping and marquee selection operate without camera saves
Pen draws strokes, eraser removes them, undo restores, wheel still pans while drawing
Ink written by another device is merged and highlighted like any record
Tags commit while typing, retain delimiters, and refresh after undo
Unsupported schema and deleted source stay recoverable without replacement writes
Narrow viewport uses a drawer and usable List view (desktop emulation only)
Stress fixture: 300 nodes, 500 connections; load, interaction timings and culling
Repeated open/close releases React roots, subscriptions and clean sessions
Disabling the plugin leaves readable fenced JSON in the source note

stress.note: CDP-driven event/paint latency includes automation overhead; not a claimed device FPS.
